rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses (in or out of Kansas) from colleges/universities, ADA/NDA and ADHA/NDHA and their societies, Board-recognized academies and specialty organizations, local dental/hygiene societies, study clubs, VA/armed forces programs; commercial courses if eligible; home study allowed with hours reviewed by the Board
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE waived for the first year after graduation and licensure.
rules.alternatives: Full-time graduate study, internship or residency in dentistry/dental hygiene waives CE; retired or disabled licensees waived.

topics.who: Current AHA BLS for the health care provider (or equivalent) certificate submitted with renewal; hours count

rules.notes: Specialist certificate holders: at least 40 of the 60 hours in their specialty. Current AHA BLS for the health care provider (or Board-approved equivalent) certificate must be submitted with renewal; its hours count toward CE. Licenses expire December 1 and renew biennially (K.S.A. 65-1431). Up to 10 h/year for lecturing or teaching.
